description: Change an Asana task's completion, assignee, due date or name, or append to its notes (never replaces them). Cannot change custom fields. Refuses on a lead whose portal-link email is pending. Preview first; apply with confirm: true and the preview_id. Sign-in required.

append_notes.description: Text added to the end of the description. Never replaces it.

assignee_email.description: New assignee's email; must be in the firm's Asana.

confirm.description: Must be omitted or false on the first call — that only previews. Never invent a preview_id. After the person agrees, call again with confirm: true AND the preview_id this server returned.

due_on.description: New due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again. Defaults to preview_id.

preview_id.description: Exactly the preview_id this server returned on a prior call for these arguments. Required with confirm: true. Never generate or reuse one from another tool or conversation.

task_id.description: Asana task id from list_matter_tasks, search_tasks or get_task.

name: update_task
title: Update Asana task
